nodes.title: SG-5.5.1 Remove duplicate SceneObject import and field in BootScene
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts declares `import type { SceneObject }` twice (L12 and L14) and the `private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = []` field twice (L22 and L23). Desired behavior: one import and one field remain. Expected result: no new type errors. Why: duplicate identifiers break compilation of the Phaser scene wrapper.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.ts, when it is read, then exactly one `import type { SceneObject }` line exists
- Given BootScene.ts, when it is read, then exactly one `private sceneObjects` field exists
- Given the frontend, when tsc --noEmit runs, then no duplicate identifier error is reported for BootScene.ts


## Scope
- In scope: Delete duplicate import and field in BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: Behavior changes to BootScene
- Out of scope: Other files
- Preserve: buildScene wiring
- Preserve: objectClick forwarding
- Preserve: sync on state change
- Preserve: shutdown cleanup


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- No new type errors


## Definition of done
- Duplicates removed and BootScene compiles


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene has a single sceneObjects field and keeps its behavior
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.ts lines 22 and 23 both declare `private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = []`. Desired behavior: keep one field. Expected result: create(), onStateChange() and the SHUTDOWN handler still use this.sceneObjects unchanged. Why: a duplicate class member is a compile error.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.ts, when searched for `private sceneObjects`, then exactly one match exists
- Given a created BootScene with a mocked buildScene, when state changes, then every SceneObject.sync receives the state
- Given SHUTDOWN is emitted, when handled, then every SceneObject.destroy is called


## Scope
- In scope: Field declarations of BootScene
- Out of scope: create/onStateChange logic changes
- Preserve: Existing bootSceneBuild and bootSceneSync tests


## Technical constraints
- Field type stays SceneObject[]


## Definition of done
- One field remains and behavior is unchanged


## Clarifying questions
- None
